newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH TPSA PLN 350 MLN CPS SCHEME PLANNED FOR AUG.
newsitem.headline: POLISH TPSA PLN 350 MLN CPS SCHEME PLANNED FOR AUG.

text.p: Poland's telecommunications monopolist TPSA will launch a 350 million zloty commercial paper programme aimed at domestic and foreign investors in August, the issue's manager said on Friday.
"The offer will be aimed at institutional investors...both domestic and foreign ones," Jaroslaw Grodzki, director of Bank Handlowy's Capital Operations Centre, told a news conference.
Grodzki said TPSA would issue two- and three-month CPs and that the first tranche of the three-year programme would take place in the second ten days of August.
"There will be a number of tranches...this will depend on TPSA's needs," Grodzki said.
The price of the papers, to be sold at a discount, will be set separately at every tender on the basis of demand.
TPSA president Jacek Gadomski, also present, said the CP programme was a test run for the company, which plans to seek more financing on the market in the future.
"This will be a test baloon, we want to see how the market reacts," Gadomski said.
TPSA plans to use the funds for an extensive investment programme aimed at increasing the number of telephones from 17 telephones per 100 Polish residents to 27 by the year 2000.
